Meaning: Nine sequential clean native E3M6/maximized/16-worker/Pairs/Strips/audio stress captures, three per style, full30-track local catalog.420 exact commands and two prior checkpoints repeat; the player dies, ending health0/kills0, so this is not ordinary combat navigation or map completion. Replay has a null original source fingerprint; capture manifests pin actual measured runtime and input hashes. Collection has no concurrent tests/exports/recordings/analyzers; low-frequency status/source reads are retained separately. All full windows and failures remain. Style groups are sequential and fonts differ, so this is a workload matrix rather than a paired causal encoding comparison. Raw CSV counts/p99, source/command/audio/credit/PCM/UI accounting are independently verified. Sampled memory/CPU include host/simulation/16 renderers, exclude the separate audio worker and Terminal, and miss unsampled startup/tails; correct that collector gap before claiming total game-process resource usage. ETW events do not identify optical unique game frames. Full campaign, fidelity, acoustic/physical input/1080-DPI/second-hardware gates stay open.

ResourceSamplingScope: Host, simulation and sixteen renderers only. Separate audio worker and Terminal excluded; whole-game budget and CPU total remain unqualified. Earlier collector cohorts have the same omission.
SceneOutcome: All nine runs preserve both recorded endpoints but end in player death: Health0,Kills0,OutcomeStopped. No route tuning or map-completion claim.
